about: Alycen A. Moss is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Atlanta, Georgia area. Providing legal representation in Georgia for a variety of different issues, Alycen Moss was selected to Super Lawyers for 2019 - 2027.

After completing undergraduate studies, Alycen A. Moss attended law school. Alycen Moss was enrolled at Georgia State University College of Law. She earned a juris doctor degree in 1998. Alycen Moss was admitted to the practice of law in 1998.

Attorneys like Alycen A. Moss are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Alycen Moss represents clients with Civil Litigation: Defense issues. Additional legal issues represented include Insurance Coverage and Transportation / Maritime.
